scientific_integrity: The four-variable obstruction is proved analytically; exhaustive checks cover 960 cubic-plus-quadratic instances, with linear terms invariant. Independent review has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Existence only, not an orbit classification. The exact degree-three condition is necessary; a quadratic with nondegenerate polar separates in dimension four. General positive dimensions use previously published direct-sum results. Historical priority beyond named inspected literature is not independently certified.
title: A four-variable obstruction and the exact dimension spectrum for ordered-separating cubic Boolean functions
